versionFieldNote: Be explicit about what is actually enforced. allowlistVersion IS machine-checked: extraction/verify_all.py's version-parity check fails the run if it drifts from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's own version field, and that check is proven to catch drift by `verify_all.py --prove-drift`. repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are DOCUMENTATION-ONLY, hand-maintained markers -- nothing checks them automatically. No version field here implies an enforcement guarantee it does not have.

approvalFlags.legalContentSignOffNote: REQUIRED BEFORE ANY REAL DEPLOYMENT. src/data/legal/terms.js and privacy.js in the source project hold the real company's operative legal text, ported verbatim. Whoever owns legal/content must sign off. assetRole legal.operativeText is pinned to must-not-fabricate and the schema exposes no body field, so a generator cannot write legal prose -- but that is a safety rail, not a substitute for sign-off.
approvalFlags.assetLicensingNote: REQUIRED. The source is a real, live company's site. Real third-party press marks (Forbes, The New York Times, Parents, mom.com), the Otter wordmark, brand illustrations and photographs of real people are all present in the source project. assets/asset-roles.json bans reproducing or imitating them; a human still has to confirm the licensing position for anything shipped.
approvalFlags.publishNote: This design-repo is not to be published and the repository is not to be made public.

marketing.engine: Webflow-derived markup rebuilt in React + Vite + Tailwind v3

auth.note: A SEPARATE design system in its own token namespace. Different grid (508px content column inside a 540px container), different breakpoints (Mantine min-width em: 576/768/992/1200/1408, NONE of which fire on that screen), different spacing (4/8/16/32/48), different radii (12/16/24), line-height 1.55, and no card or panel at all. Shares only the two font families and the brand hexes with the marketing site. Must never be merged into it.

countsNote: Every number in `counts` is RECOMPUTED FROM DISK by extraction/verify_all.py's manifest-counts check, which fails the run on any mismatch. A manifest is not self-verifying just because it looks internally coherent -- it has to be checked against the files it summarises. Proven to catch a hand-bumped number by `verify_all.py --prove-drift`.
entryPointsNote: Every path here is INSIDE design-repo/ and is verified to exist by verify_all.py's self-contained check. There are deliberately no ../ paths to the sibling source project: an entry point is a promise about this package's own contents, and a standalone copy or an extracted zip must not reference files it does not contain. External build-time evidence is recorded in extraction/measured-values.json instead, which degrades gracefully (warns, does not fail) when no sibling source tree is present.

dependencies.python: stdlib only -- the repo ships schema/_draft7.py, its own draft-07 validator, so no pip install is needed
dependencies.optional: the reference `jsonschema` package, used only by `verify_all.py --cross-check` as an independent second opinion

snapshotNote: A design-repo is a snapshot, not a living mirror of its source project. The source can be upgraded after this was built with nothing re-checking these claims. If the project has moved on, re-diff the framework versions, counts and factual claims in extraction/measured-values.json against current source rather than trusting this snapshot.
